property_summary: After any sequence of successful fallback calls, pastBlockTime is always strictly greater than the block timestamp at the time of every call in the sequence; the mutant allows a call where pastBlockTime equals block.timestamp + 1, then any subsequent call reverts because require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) is never satisfiable.
change_summary: Move pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1 before the second require statement.
